meta.name: QuartzOS Reference Data
meta.description: Production-grade reference data for cannabis concentrate dabbing — banger form factors, concentrates, sensors, and temperature calibrations. Sourced from manufacturer documentation (Dab Rite, Highly Educated, Quave, Honeybee Herb), brand guidance (710 Labs, Mood, Press Club), and 2025-2026 community consensus.
meta.license: Open data for non-commercial integration. Verify temperature recommendations against current community testing before production deployment.
meta.temperature_convention: All concentrate.surface_temp_f values are INTERIOR SURFACE temperatures (probe-truth, Terpometer V1 contact). Sensor readings on instruments differ — use the sensor + banger.ir_offset_f + banger.ir_offset_sign math to convert.
data_sources: Dab Rite official documentation and 2025 placement guide (dabrite.com)
420 VapeZone empirical Dab Rite + slurper testing
Press Club temple ball / hash temp guidance

bangers.description: Quartz banger form factors in active 2025-2026 production. Each entry contains geometry, temperature ranges, IR calibration data, torch technique, and procedure metadata.

fields.name: Display name
fields.category: One of: classic | slurper | specialty | premium
fields.geometry: Thermal class for IR offset math: bucket | slurper | insert | enail. Drives ir_offset_sign.
fields.surface_temp_range_f: [low, high] interior surface temp where this banger is operable
fields.ir_offset_sign: Direction of offset: -1 = display reads LOWER than interior (bucket-class, IR sees cooler exterior wall); +1 = display reads HIGHER than interior (slurper-class, side-of-column wall is thinner and hotter); 0 = no offset (e-nail PID is its own system)
fields.ir_aim_location: Where to aim the IR thermometer (the most-disputed UX spec — verified against Dab Rite 2025 placement guide)
fields.heat_time_seconds: Total torch time as a string range (some bangers have multi-stage breakdowns)
fields.cooldown_seconds: Wait time after torch-off before dabbing
fields.torch_pattern: circular_sweep | circular_sweep_outer_only | circular_sweep_floor | sequenced | simultaneous_sweep | none
fields.torch_zones: Array of {anatomy, time_pct} describing where to focus the flame
fields.torch_distance_inches: Distance from inner-cone tip of Blazer Big Shot to quartz
fields.notable_manufacturers: Array of brands producing this form factor in 2026

concentrates.description: Cannabis concentrates in active 2025-2026 rotation. surface_temp_f values are INTERIOR SURFACE temps (Terpometer-equivalent, not Dab Rite IR readings).

fields.name: Display name
fields.surface_temp_optimal_f: Single optimal interior surface temp (midpoint of range or community consensus)
fields.good_for_cold_start: Boolean — concentrate benefits from cold-start workflow
fields.blocked: If present, this concentrate should NOT be dabbed. Value is the user-facing explanation.
fields.warning: If present, soft warning to display alongside dab recommendation
fields.notes: Array of contextual notes / why-this-temp explanations

sensors.description: Temperature measurement instruments. Method drives the calibration formula branch.

fields.name: Display name
fields.calibration_note: How this instrument relates to interior surface temp

wall_thicknesses.description: Banger wall thickness modifier. Thinner walls heat and cool faster.

fields.name: Display name
fields.modifier_f: °F to add to surface temp target (thicker = positive, thinner = negative)

explanation: 1. Start with concentrate.surface_temp_optimal_f (interior surface — what the dab actually contacts)
2. Apply wall.modifier_f (thicker walls hold more heat, target slightly higher)
3. Multiply banger.ir_offset_f by banger.ir_offset_sign (-1 for bucket-class, +1 for slurper-class, 0 for e-nail)
4. Add result to surface temp to get the displayed temp on the user's instrument

examples.scenario: Live Resin + Flat Top + IR + Standard wall
examples.math: 510 (interior) + 0 (wall) + (-1 * 35) (bucket-class IR offset) = 475°F displayed on Dab Rite

examples.scenario: Live Resin + Blender + IR + Standard wall
examples.math: 510 (interior) + 0 (wall) + (+1 * 20) (slurper-class IR offset) = 530°F displayed on Dab Rite

examples.scenario: Cold Cure Rosin + Terp Slurper + IR + Standard wall
examples.math: 460 (interior) + 0 (wall) + (+1 * 20) (slurper-class IR offset) = 480°F displayed on Dab Rite

examples.scenario: Live Resin + Flat Top + Probe + Standard wall
examples.math: 510 (interior) + 0 (wall) + 0 (probe is contact, no offset) = 510°F displayed on Terpometer

examples.scenario: Live Resin + E-Banger + PID + Standard wall

calibration.workflow_note: For IR-mode users: the Dab Rite alarms when temp DESCENDS through the set point. Torch past the displayed target, pull the flame, then dab when the alarm fires on the way down. Don't dab AT peak torch.
